EX-ANTE: file a decision receipt BEFORE the event (hypothesis + predicted Y-gate + pre-committed move + falsifier) so you can be scored later. FORGE: pressure-test the brief's own claims against external substrates via an independent skeptic (grounded / inference / struck). RECOIL: after the event, close the receipt — belief-update ledger (confidence x conviction), kairos/quiet-signals, risk flags, next steps. WAR GAME: adversarial + kinematic — measured manifold, BAR/LAB/COURT gauntlet, ATG pre-mortem on the critical path vs their real objections. DEFENSIBILITY: translate the method into the counterpart's native register (Rosetta) + a 5-verb x 4-proofing matrix + the antifragile-core / lossless-translation test.
